# LetterTrace

A letter (a–z, A–Z) or pre-writing shape to trace, on writing lines: the model with its start dot and numbered strokes, or a dashed copy to trace.

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- Shapes come from design/letters.json (tools/build_letters.py): Victorian foundation style, strokes in the order taught, each from its start point. Never hand-drawn per product.
- Writing lines: top, waist (dashed) and descender in the light guide colour, the baseline darker.
- Model: solid purple strokes, a gold start dot and the stroke's number at each start, and an arrow showing the way. Copies to trace: dashed, with the start dot.
- In the app the child traces with a finger: a short purple arrow just ahead of the gold dot, following the stroke's curve, shows which way to go; the stroke turns purple as it's followed (only from its start, in its direction), the next stroke's dot and arrow appear, and a finished letter bursts a star (not with reduced motion). Lifting the finger part-way through a stroke isn't a mistake: what's traced after it takes the next lift colour (teal, pink, blue, green, sun-deep, then round again), and when the letter is done every colour fades into purple. The words above stay the same size, so the letter never moves.
- Each letter is read out: "Letter a. 1 stroke."

Tokens: `component.letter` (model, trace, guide, base, start, start-line, number, lift-1, lift-2, lift-3, lift-4, lift-5) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website has no activities. |
| Design System | `.fmt-letter`, `<LetterTrace>` |
| App | `FmtLetterTrace` |
